name: Teng Lin
source: Teng Lin is an emigrant escaping along with Yin Xiao-Feng. She is easy to adapt herself to the place she is now at, mostly thanks to her happy and kind personality. She met Yin Xiao-Feng when they were escaping in the escape boat.
